newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY OVERNIGHT RATES END LOWER AT 21.5 PERCENT.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY OVERNIGHT RATES END LOWER AT 21.5 PERCENT.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates dropped 1.5 percent on Tuesday and traders said further easing was likely over the next few days.
"Overnight rates could go down to around 21 percent or slightly lower," said Istvan Zsoter of Takarekbank.

Overnight rates closed at 21.50 percent, down from Monday's close of 23 percent in ample liquidity. Abundant forint supply is a usual phenomenon near the end of the banks' two-week reserve periods.--Denes Albert,Budapest newsroom +36 1 327-4040
